component.name: Things for GNOME
component.summary: View your Things 3 tasks natively on GNOME

description.p: An unofficial, native GNOME client that reads your Things 3 tasks from Things Cloud, so you can see your Inbox, Today, Upcoming, Anytime, Someday and Logbook on Linux without reaching for your Mac or iPhone.
Read-only in this version. Not affiliated with Cultured Code.
First release: live Things Cloud sync, native sidebar and lists.
